notes: Leafkin Druid, printed: '{T}: Add {G}. If you control four or more creatures, add {G}{G} instead.' I control four creatures (the Druid and three Bears), and the Druid is my only mana source. Casting Barkhide Troll ({G}{G}) by tapping pays the whole cost from one tap of the Druid, so it adds exactly {G}{G}: the Troll is cast, the Druid is tapped and no mana is left over.
